slides.title: Story 1: Growth Beat Forecasts
slides.body: The first estimate for July to September beat forecasts of about 3.2%. On Oct 28, the Fed held rates at 3.75% to 4.00%, with two dissents favoring a hike.

slides.title: Story 2: Inflation Moved Up
slides.subtitle: PCE price index (% year over year)
slides.body: Number of the week: 3.6%. Prices rose 0.5% from August.

slides.title: Story 3: AI Spending Doubts
slides.body: On Oct 29, Alphabet fell 12.6%, its worst day ever, as investors questioned AI spending and cash flow. The Nasdaq dropped about 1.4%.
